messages:
kai (AE): Urgent: prospect's POC fails with 413 when they POST a single payload containing a 25k-token doc + images. Demo in <24h, need quick remediation.

Maya (Solutions): Likely gateway client_max_body_size. Can you paste client curl and approximate bytes?

kai (AE): curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @huge.json
```
~3.5MB. Response 413 Request Entity Too Large.

Ethan (Eng): Confirmed - hosted gateway defaults to ~2MB. Options: 1) client chunking + stitch (lowest friction), 2) presigned upload + server fetch, 3) request temporary increase for demo (support ticket).

Maya (Solutions): For chunking: sliding window 3-4k tokens, overlap 150-250 tokens, call embeddings/generation per chunk, then merge. Pseudo: windows = slide(doc,4096,overlap=200); outs = map(api.chat, windows); merged = stitch(outs).

Rhea (Support): Gzip helps only for transport size; gateway still enforces decompressed limit and some proxies mishandle gzip. I'll file a ticket for a possible temporary bump if they need single-call.

ticket-bot: Created ticket #S-11022 at 2026-04-05T08:45:12Z

kai (AE): Customer prefers minimal changes now. I'll send the chunking snippet and ask if they want the temp bump for the live demo.

Ethan (Eng): Note: also check model's context cap (32k/8k). Even with gateway lift, model will truncate; include a preflight check that counts tokens and returns a helpful error advising chunking or Dedicated.

Maya (Solutions): I'll draft a one-page playbook: chunking example, overlap guidance, presigned-upload sample, and contact for temp limit.

kai (AE): Perfect, thanks everyone. Will report back after demo.
